kaa.mistake_note_md: Modulge ashqanda túbir qaysı sanlar arasında ekenin bahalamay belgini shatastırıw.

en.solution_md: Since $4^{2}<44<10^{2}$, we get $4<\sqrt{44}<10$: both expressions are positive. $\sqrt{44}-4+10-\sqrt{44}=6$ Answer: $6$.
en.mistake_note_md: Opening the modulus without estimating which integers the root lies between, and mixing up the sign.
